fees.notes: Unverified international fee: UiTM's official International Postgraduate Education guide (https://ipsis.uitm.edu.my/images/Admission/BROCHURE_INTERNATIONAL_2024.pdf, ed. 2024) prices postgraduate awards only (USD3,000-13,000 per programme); StudyMalaysia lists only local fees (RM200/sem) for UiTM. Diploma/undergraduate places at UiTM are restricted to Bumiputera (Malaysian) candidates, so no international fee is published for this programme. The figure shown is an unverified local/subsidised estimate.
